children: China's vice commerce minister, Ling Ji, met on Monday with representatives from Novo Nordisk
among others in Beijing, a ministry statement released on Tuesday said.
China will "provide stability and certainty for the operations of foreign-invested enterprises in China," Ling said during a meeting with more than 30 foreign firms, the statement added.
